The fact is that, as Benjamin Franklin once said, “An investment in knowledge pays the best interest.” I think that was a fact already when Franklin was active, but it is even more so in a global community: human capital plays a critical role. Secondly, digitalization. When we look at the future estimations of what is going to be the impact of the digital age on employment, for example, there are several quite reliable estimations starting from the fact that probably one third of our existing jobs will disappear over the next 20 years.
